title: Coherence of normalized common-stage Hom comparisons
statement: Fix the common-stage Hom data and a coefficient inclusion L ≤ M. After transporting the normalized Hom representative from L to M, the operation-stage transition and stage-system associators identify it with the normalized comparison at M applied to the transported input arrows.

source.place: The common-stage internal-Hom comparison definition; missing coherence between operationStageTransitionIso, normalized rational Hom comparisons, and stage-system associators.

proof.text: Expand commonStageHomComparison at L and M into operation-stage transition, normalized rational Hom comparison, and the two stage associators. Apply the rationalized scalar Hom tower and naturality equations to the middle Hom map, then use functoriality of the derived internal Hom and cancellation of adjacent comparison isomorphisms. The coefficient-inclusion tower law identifies the direct M comparison with the transported L comparison, yielding the displayed coherence square.

theorem commonStageHomComparison_hom_square
    (M : Index l Ω) (k : L ≤ M) :
    let cP_L := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W P L h
    let cQ_L := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W Q L h'
    let cP_M := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W P M (h.trans k)
    let cQ_M := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W Q M (h'.trans k)
    ((stageSystem l Ω W).assoc h k).inv.app
          (commonStageHomObject l Ω W P).obj ≫
      ((stageSystem l Ω W).T k).map
        (cP_L.hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedInternalHom l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) W).map
            (ObjectProperty.homMk
              (X := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W P L h)
              (Y := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W Q L h') (Prod.mkHom a.op b)) ≫
          cQ_L.inv) ≫
      ((stageSystem l Ω W).assoc h' k).hom.app
          (commonStageHomObject l Ω W Q).obj =
    cP_M.hom ≫
      (rationalDerivedInternalHom l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω M) W).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W P M (h.trans k))
          (Y := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W Q M (h'.trans k))
          (Prod.mkHom ((stageSystem l Ω W).tr k a).op
            ((stageSystem l Ω W).tr k b))) ≫
      cQ_M.inv
